episode_summary: Valerie Fitzgerald shares her inspiring journey from a single mother with no contacts to a top luxury real estate agent. She emphasizes the importance of embracing fear, leveraging relationships, and continuously reinventing oneself. Valerie also discusses the role of AI in modern real estate and offers practical advice for breaking into the luxury market.
